title: Prepare a client spreadsheet for Selestial
sampleData: public/templates/selestial-clients.csv plus the rows below. Example names, example.com emails and 555 numbers only.

scenes.narration: This shows how to prepare a client spreadsheet that Selestial can read. In Selestial's import step, choose Download the client template.
The template has one header row. Each column holds one detail: name, email, phone, and each part of the address.

capture.what: The downloaded template open in Google Sheets. Slowly move the cursor along the header row.

scenes.narration: Put each client on their own row. Fill in the street, city, state and ZIP together. That's what creates the client's property in Selestial.

capture.what: Type a third sample row: Morgan Example, morgan@example.com, 512-555-0102, 300 Sample Rd, Austin, TX, 78703. Highlight street to ZIP cells.

scenes.narration: Remove totals, blank rows and notes above the header, so the first row is always the header.

capture.what: Start from a copy with a title line above the header and a totals row; delete both.

scenes.narration: Save the sheet as a CSV file. In Google Sheets, choose File, then Download, then Comma-separated values.

capture.what: File > Download > Comma-separated values (.csv). Show the download finishing.

scenes.narration: Return to Selestial and upload the file you just saved.

actions.target: text=Choose a spreadsheet of your clients
